title: Invariant Gibbs measures and global dynamics for fractional cubic Schrödinger equations on the torus
summary: We consider the defocusing Wick-ordered cubic fractional nonlinear Schrödinger equation on the two-dimensional torus with dispersion relation $ω(k)=|k|^α$. In the weakly dispersive regime $\frac{29}{15}<α<2$, we construct global dynamics for almost every initial datum with respect to the associated Gibbs measure as the limit of the finite-dimensional truncated flows and prove invariance of the Gibbs measure.
